design: Layer14 projected-head residual repairs, nine heads indexed0-8. Frozen second-wording first4-item means. All predicted/all9 repaired,9 single exact residual repairs,9 leave-one-predicted controls, crossed predicted/exact boundary states. Other attention layers remain mean-predicted. All96 transfer cases retained. Capture pre-output-projection head vectors and project each head separately; audit sum and residual reconstruction.
limitations: Head repairs use heldout donor outputs and are diagnostics, not predictors. Attention-head structural basis is architecture-defined, not a discovered unique semantic basis. Mean approximation error and task computation are distinct; no causal shares.
